name: dive_down_hexproof_stops_opponent_targeting_this_turn_only
notes: P97ff120a42 G4. Printed: 'Target creature you control gets +0/+3 and gains hexproof until end of turn. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)' Seat 0 casts Dive Down on its 2/2. Seat 1's Mortify ('Destroy target creature or enchantment') cannot target it this turn (refused, nothing paid). On seat 1's own turn hexproof is gone and Mortify destroys the 2/2.
